nodes.label: LLZO garnet suppresses Li dendrites
nodes.summary: High shear modulus (G > 55 GPa) of cubic Li7La3Zr2O12 mechanically blocks lithium filament penetration.

nodes.label: Murugan et al. & Janek Group (2021)
nodes.summary: Demonstrates stable Li stripping/plating for >500 cycles in dense hot-pressed Al-doped LLZO pellets at 0.3 mA/cm².

nodes.label: Porz, Chiang & Bruce et al. (2022)
nodes.summary: Refutes mechanical suppression above 0.8 mA/cm²: Li nucleates inside pre-existing grain-boundary Griffith flaws regardless of bulk shear modulus.

nodes.label: Ag-C Interlayer Stack Pressure (Samsung 2020)
nodes.summary: Achieves 1000 Wh/L pouch cell stability using 5 µm Ag-C nanocomposite anode layer with argyrodite Li6PS5Cl.

nodes.label: Low-Pressure Pouch Failure (Meng et al. 2024)
nodes.summary: Shows Ag-C sulfide cells suffer contact voiding and rapid capacity fade when external stack pressure drops below 2 MPa at 25°C.

nodes.label: Pulse-heated LLZO/Ag-C hybrid is stable below 1 MPa stack pressure
nodes.summary: Zero published studies test whether localized millisecond thermal annealing heals grain-boundary flaws under consumer EV stack pressure (<0.8 MPa).
